caveat.row: A cluster of people-group pins within ~25 km, not a municipal boundary. Each pin marks a people group, not a town, so clusters are never named by inference: the {n} multi-group centres were resolved by {source} (ODbL, cited per row), and the rest stay unnamed rather than guessed.
caveat.internet: They are shown as context: per-city connectivity is not publicly available at this scale, and a national figure must not be read as a city measurement.
caveat.scope: This page carries people-group locations and connectivity only — no church, believer or meeting-point data, by design.
